display_long_description:
Experience high-octane aerial combat like never before!

In Death Copter: Tactical Strike, you are an elite tactical gunner assigned to the world’s most dangerous mission zones. Strapped into a moving helicopter, you must use your reflexes and precision to neutralize enemy threats from the sky.

Step into a fully immersive VR world where you can switch between precision pistols and heavy-duty machine guns to take down enemies hiding in fortified buildings. This isn't just about shooting; it’s about tactical survival.

Key Features:

Immersive 360° Gunplay: Use your Quest controllers to aim and shoot in any direction as you circle the battlefield.

Dynamic Weapon Switching: Switch between different firearms in real-time to adapt to your mission's needs.

Challenging Tactical Missions: Clear out enemy-occupied towers and secure the zone to progress through increasingly difficult levels.

Realistic Haptic Feedback: Feel the kick of every shot and the vibration of the helicopter, making the action feel truly alive.

Action-Packed Environments: Fly through detailed 3D cityscapes and industrial zones filled with destructible elements and enemy AI.

Comfort Optimized for VR: Designed for a smooth experience with stable cockpit views to ensure comfort during intense flight maneuvers.

The mission is ready. The chopper is airborne. Do you have what it takes to clear the zone?
